appeared_text: Virginia residents can opt out of targeted advertising, the sale of personal data, and profiling used for decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. No account is required.
Opt out of sale and targeted ads
Ads selected from your activity over time and across nonaffiliated websites and apps, including retargeting, audience matching, and campaign optimization.
Exchange of device identifiers, shopping activity, and a hashed email with advertising partners for valuable consideration.
Marlow does not use personal data for credit, housing, insurance, employment, or similar decisions. You can still record an opt-out.
A real device signal opts you out of sale and targeted advertising without an account. This demo can apply the same result.
An authorized agent may opt out for you by emailing privacy@marlow.example with your name and signed permission. Opting out keeps prices, service, and loyalty rewards.
We use account details to fulfill orders and support. A hashed email may be used for audience matching while targeted advertising is on.
The starting demo password is harbor418. Passwords stay on this device and are never part of a data sale.

Uses this phone’s own lock. Marlow does not collect biometric data.
We store brand, last four, expiration, and name. Full card numbers are not kept.
Order and promo messages are separate from targeted advertising. Sale and cross-app ad choices live under Privacy choices.
When a carrier is on the way.
Drops on items you saved in Marlow.
Suggestions from your activity inside Marlow. This is separate from targeted advertising.
Send a receipt for each purchase.
Currency is US dollars. Marlow ships within Virginia and prices orders from the store you pick.
Rewards stay if you opt out of sale or targeted advertising. Loyalty is not conditioned on a sale of personal data.

Last updated October 20, 2026. This notice covers Virginia residents who use Marlow.
Marlow Home Supply, LLC, 412 E Main Street, Richmond, VA 23219.
Account information: name, email, phone, and addresses

We do not collect sensitive data as defined by the Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act, including precise location, health information, biometrics, or personal data of a known child. Device unlock stays on your phone. This app is not directed to children under 13.
How we use it and who receives it
We use this data to run your account, orders, deliveries, payments, support, security, and loyalty program.
Recommendations inside Marlow use your activity in Marlow. Those suggestions are separate from targeted advertising.

If you allow targeted advertising, we use personal data from your activity over time and across nonaffiliated websites and mobile apps to predict shopping preferences and to support targeted advertising, retargeting, audience matching, and campaign optimization.
Payment, shipping, cloud hosting, and support companies receive only what they need to perform that work. That disclosure is processing, not a sale.
Signed-in requests are authenticated. We respond within 45 days, with one possible 45-day extension if we tell you.
You have not filed a privacy request yet.
How long do privacy requests take?
Access, correction, deletion, and download requests are completed within 45 days. We may extend once by another 45 days and will tell you if we do. Appeals receive a response within 60 days.
Prices are in US dollars. Virginia deliveries follow the store you select. Open orders finish even if you later opt out of advertising or request deletion of other data.
Points and Gold status are part of a bona fide rewards program. They do not depend on allowing a sale of personal data or targeted advertising.
Virginia privacy rights are described in the privacy notice. These terms do not waive them.
These terms are governed by Virginia law. Consumer privacy requests follow the Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act.
You can still opt out of sale and targeted advertising on the sign-in screen. No account is required for that opt-out.
